text:
claire: Hey folks - proposing a new monthly "Recog Corner" drop-in (20m) during lunch for quick nomination help + Q&A. Thinking 1st Fri of month, 12:15pm PT. Would anyone like to co-run the pilot?

maria: Love it. I can co-run the pilot and bring templates. Can we make it hybrid? Small room + Zoom.

ash: I can do Zoom host. Quick ask: can we add a short checklist for managers about eligibility? Sometimes they get tripped up on timing.

claire: Good point. I'll draft a 1-page checklist: who qualifies, frequency limits, tax note, and examples.

ben: Food logistics: if we host in-person, keep it simple (sandwich boxes). Budget ok up to $150 per session?

finance-bot: Reminder: per-session catering limit is $200 for small events. Submit receipts in Concur under project code REC-OPS.

maria: I'll collect interest via a quick form and cap in-person to 18. Also will add a slot for people to submit anonymized nomination drafts for live feedback.

zoe: Quick note for comms: emphasize "bring a one-line story" so folks come prepared. I can draft a Slack blurb and post it tomorrow.

claire: Awesome - checklist + form + comms by Wed EOD, pilot session next Fri. If anyone else wants to co-present an example, reply here. Thanks!
